translations.from: Your order has been successfully placed.
Oops! Something went wrong. Please try again.
Your Click to Pay email address
translations.to: Click to Pay 邮箱地址

translations.from: A classic polo shirt for all occasions. Playing golf? Pair it with some khakis. Preppy party? Pop that collar! Let your polo reflect your personality, so your brain doesn’t have to.
translations.to: 适合各种场合的经典 Polo 衫。打高尔夫时搭配卡其裤，聚会时竖起衣领，让 Polo 衫展现你的个性。

translations.from: Audio perfection, award-winning noise cancellation, and a design as sleek as a sports car. Don’t be fooled by the price, these are the best headphones on the market—guaranteed!
translations.to: 出色音质、获奖降噪技术与流线型设计。别被价格迷惑，这是一款出色的耳机。

translations.from: Surf, sand, and sunglasses: summertime perfection. These aviator sunnies protect your precious peepers from hazardous UV rays, day or night. Bonus: they make you look kinda cool.
translations.to: 冲浪、沙滩与太阳镜，夏日的理想搭配。这款飞行员太阳镜可以保护双眼免受紫外线伤害，也让你看起来更酷。

translations.from: These boots fall above the ankle, so you don’t need to buy those no-show half socks that constantly fall off your heels. We think these boots are waterproof, but please let us know.
translations.to: 高于脚踝的短靴，让你不必再穿总会从脚跟滑落的隐形袜。我们认为它防水，欢迎告诉我们你的使用体验。

translations.from: A generic ticket to an unspecified event on either May 10 or October 5 (depending on which side of the pond you hail from). One seat only, one night only. No refunds, no regrets.
translations.to: 一张活动门票，日期是 5 月 10 日或 10 月 5 日，取决于你习惯的日期写法。一个座位，仅此一晚，不予退款。

translations.from: Also called a backsack, knapsack, rucksack, or packsack, this is the preferred load-carrying method of hikers and students. We think these ones are waterproof, but please let us know.
translations.to: 无论叫背包还是行囊，它都是徒步者和学生喜爱的携物方式。我们认为它防水，欢迎告诉我们你的使用体验。

translations.from: Maybe you need this device for your existing gaming console. Maybe you just want to pretend you’ve got a gaming console. We’re not here to judge! Buy, and you shall receive joy.
translations.to: 你可能需要它来搭配现有游戏机，也可能只是想假装自己有一台游戏机。买下它，收获快乐。

translations.from: Just like your school cafeteria’s menu in the last few days before summer break, this “manager’s special” mealbox is a mystery. On the plus side, we’ll deliver it right to your doorstep.
translations.to: 就像暑假前学校食堂的菜单，这份特价餐盒的内容充满惊喜。好消息是，我们会把它送到你的门口。

translations.from: The dorsal fin of an orca whale. An actual oil slick. The earthly manifestation of a black hole. Nighttime with pockets. Vantablack lining. The world’s most elusive handbag.
translations.to: 如虎鲸的背鳍、如油面、如黑洞，也像带口袋的夜色。这是一款神秘的深黑色手提包。
